# duoqueue.io Watch Page Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Ship website option 2 ("Wildcard") from `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-23-duoqueue-io-watch-page-design.md`: the film on its own dark `/watch/` pages, three matching animated cards instead of the chopped fragments, no closing lockup, CSS-only motion.

**Architecture:** The site is generated by `scripts/build-site.mjs` (3,135 lines, no framework) into `site/` and published by `scripts/deploy-site.mjs`. The finished look already exists as hand-edited HTML in the Wildcard prototype; this plan ports that markup and CSS into the generator functions, adds the judges' fixes, and updates deploy checks and the privacy policy.

**Tech Stack:** Node 24 ESM scripts, hand-written HTML/CSS, GitHub Pages, headless Chrome for renders.

**Reference implementation (read these first, copy from them):**
- `S = C:\Users\stall\AppData\Local\Temp\claude\C--Users-stall-duoqueue\55be0b61-1cfc-4cfc-b553-0f4945ecc35c\scratchpad\site`
- `S\proto-wildcard\index.html`: the finished home page (markup + all CSS, including motion blocks).
- `S\proto-wildcard\watch\index.html`: the finished watch page.
- `S\proto-move-tools\part-*.css` and `S\proto-move\index.html`: the desktop load-sequence CSS (the "move" prototype ran the three card moments once on load at 860px and wider).
- `S\wildcard-tools\pairs.mjs`: the 30 new contrast pairs with their ratios.
- `S\site-research\p-wildcard.md`: the prototype's own change list with build-site.mjs line numbers.
- Renders to match: `S\proto-wildcard\phone-390-full-rest-2up.png`, `states-01-match.png`, `states-02-duo.png`, `states-03-talk.png`, `watch-phone-first-and-scrolled.png`.

## Global Constraints

- No JavaScript on any page: zero `<script`, zero inline `on…=` handlers, zero `javascript:` URLs. The privacy policy promises "There is no JavaScript on the site at all".
- The waitlist form markup, its action URL (`WAITLIST_ENDPOINT`), the hidden source field, the 18+ checkbox, the promise line and the fine print stay byte-identical to what `signupForm(source)` emits today.
- No em dash (U+2014, `&mdash;`, `&#8212;`) in visible text or, after Task 4, anywhere in page source.
- Every colour pair passes the build's contrast audit (AA: 4.5:1 body, 3:1 large and UI).
- Every animation ends on the finished state; Reduce Motion means zero animation.
- Nothing is deployed by the implementer. The orchestrator deploys after verification.
- Commit after each task with a message that ends with `Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>`. Stage only the files the task touched (never `git add -A`; the repo has stray untracked files that must not be committed).

### Task 2: Motion (CSS only)

**Files:**
- Modify: `scripts/build-site.mjs` (`CSS`)

- [ ] **Step 1:** Port the prototype's motion blocks: hero rise-in on load (267ms each, 60ms apart), the highlighter swipe (starts 360ms, 460ms), the per-card scroll moments (`animation-timeline: view()`), the divider draws, and the slim top bar (logo + "join the waitlist ↑", shown only after the form has fully left the screen). Wrap scroll-driven rules in `@supports (animation-timeline: view())`; the top bar is `display:none` where unsupported.
- [ ] **Step 2:** Shorten each phone card's `animation-range` so its moment completes before the card's middle reaches mid-screen (use `entry 20% cover 45%` or tighter; verify in the Task 5 renders that no mid-scroll frame shows a half-typed message for longer than a short band).
- [ ] **Step 3:** At `@media (min-width: 860px)`, replace the scroll timelines with a one-time load sequence taken from the move prototype: the three cards rise at 300/360/420ms, then their moments play in order, all done by about 3.0s, so the desktop first screen is never half-built.
- [ ] **Step 4:** `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)`: `animation: none !important; transition: none !important;` for every animated selector, with the finished state as the resting style (top bar simply visible when the form is off-screen, or absent; never half-transparent).
- [ ] **Step 5:** Build (exit 0) and commit.

### Task 4: Build hygiene and the contrast audit

**Files:**
- Modify: `scripts/build-site.mjs` (`CONTRAST_PAIRS` ~715-751, `pageShell`)

- [ ] **Step 1:** Strip CSS comments when `pageShell` inlines `CSS + extraCss`:

```js
function stripCssComments(css) {
  return css.replace(/\/\*[\s\S]*?\*\//g, "");
}
// in pageShell: <style>${stripCssComments(CSS + extraCss)}</style>
```
